justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/allocationcount/AllocationCountOperation.java, InstructionAllocCountMap.java, and AllocCountMap.java plus core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/jarscan/JarScan.java. The package has only three classes and is referenced only by JarScan; its outgoing dependencies are to org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.model.bytecode (Opcode, BytecodeInstruction, MemberBytecode, IBytecodeParam) and JITWatchConstants, both of which are widely reused elsewhere in the repo (rg found 43 files using model.bytecode types and 138 using JITWatchConstants). This points to a small, low-incoming utility package depending on more stable core packages, not on less stable ones.
